result.instructions: Tools for ShopWired, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders came in today, and which are still waiting to be dispatched?"; "Find the order for jane@example.com and show its line items and tracking link."; "How many units of SKU ABC-123 are in stock?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ShopWired data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run shopwired_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shopwired_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shopwired_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. shopwired_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: shopwired_get_business
tools.title: Get business details
tools.description: Get the ShopWired business account: name, domain, default currency and package. Good first call to confirm which store the key belongs to. ShopWired API: GET /business.

tools.name: shopwired_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders, newest first by default. Filter by status id, archived flag or created date range (from/to). Each order has its id, reference, created date, status and tracking URL. ShopWired API: GET /orders.

archived.description: true = only archived orders, false = only active orders.

status.description: Only orders with this status id.

from.description: Only orders created on or after this date.

to.description: Only orders created on or before this date.

tools.name: shopwired_update_stock
tools.title: Set stock quantity
tools.description: SETS the stock quantity for one SKU, or for up to 15 SKUs in one call (items). It replaces the current value; it does not add to it. Check the current value with shopwired_get_stock first. ShopWired API: POST /stock.

sku.description: SKU to set (single update; use with quantity).

items.description: Up to 15 SKUs with their new quantities (use instead of sku and quantity).

tools.name: shopwired_update_order_status
tools.title: Update order status
tools.description: CHANGES an order's status, and optionally its tracking URL. When sendEmail is true the customer receives a status email, so only set it on purpose. Status ids come from the store's order statuses. ShopWired API: POST /orders/{id}/status.

trackingUrl.description: New tracking URL for the order.

sendEmail.description: true = email the customer about the status change (default false).
